description: Curated catalog of global skills: the single source for the generated skill tables in each agent's instruction file. The generator (scripts/gen-skill-table.mjs) reconciles this against the actual skills/global/*/ directories and fails if they disagree, so a new skill cannot silently drift out of the tables.
